name: Priest
source:
A Priest from the church located nearby Kisaragi Shrine.

An exceedingly gentlemanly laid-back kind of guy.
He will occasionally drop by at the Kisaragi Shrine to give his greetings.

Due to Nayu's differing religious views, he is often met with excessive hostility and is quickly forced to leave soon after his arrival.

[spoiler]In actually he is the creator of the world.[/spoiler]
